records.summary: Added official Coinbase evidence that XRP-backed USDC loans use Morpho on Base and require cbXRP collateral; identified the likely cbXRP/USDC market and quantified market-wide USDC debt, collateral, utilization, vault allocations and liquidation risk. Circle-issued USDC is the debt asset, but Circle is not established as lender. Added current-main audit for PR #1388 and #1386; no merge or main write.
actions: Cross-referenced Coinbase's official loan announcement, collateral terms, backup collateral asset table and loan-health documentation.
Verified XRP loans require cbXRP on Base at contract 0xcb585250f852c6c6bf90434ab21a00f02833a4af.
Inspected Morpho Watch API-derived 00:31 UTC cbXRP/USDC market data and Morpho app market ID 0xd4a903dc…6e4109.
Cross-checked Circle's official native USDC support on Base and XRPL.
Separated market-wide permissionless Morpho balances from Coinbase-specific product usage and Circle's issuer role from vault lending.
Recorded the Coinbase 4.38% penalty versus Morpho 12.67–12.68% bonus discrepancy and Morpho liquidity-field inconsistency.
Audited current main, 163 open PRs, stale base distribution, PR #1386/#1388 CI and fail-closed gates, approval workflow zero-job failure, dependencies and unavailable security-alert endpoints.
blockers: Morpho app and aggregator liquidity/utilization fields are not fully reconciled.
Coinbase channel share within the permissionless Morpho market is not disclosed.
Circle's direct market supply/lender role is unknown.
Liquidation-to-native-XRP sale path is not traced.
Coinbase and Morpho liquidation-penalty displays conflict.
Full repository CI and dependency vulnerability scan were not run.
next_actions: Reconcile Morpho market supply, borrow, available liquidity, utilization and rates from one block-consistent public API snapshot; resolve Morpho app/aggregator field differences.
Obtain the exact Coinbase UI-to-Morpho market mapping and distinguish Coinbase-originated borrowers from permissionless direct users without inferring identity from wallet heuristics.
Build 30/90-day immutable series for cbXRP supply, Morpho borrow, collateral, vault allocation, rates, liquidations and Base DEX depth.
Trace sampled liquidation transactions from Morpho collateral seizure through cbXRP DEX sale, Coinbase redemption and any XRPL/CEX transfer; do not assume the full chain.
Clarify the Coinbase 4.38% penalty versus Morpho 12.67–12.68% liquidation bonus and the generic 86% note versus the market-specific 62.5% LLTV.
Identify vault-level USDC suppliers only from public, attributable records; do not attribute vault capital to Circle without direct evidence.
Keep all collateral and stablecoin measures out of price-prediction features until point-in-time history, data-quality checks, leakage controls and walk-forward tests pass.
